task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into the Nx Witness VMS web interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the Nx Witness login page followed by the main dashboard or camera settings page at https://localhost:7001.

task_completion.description: Agent locates the 'Server Room Camera' in the device list.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot showing 'Server Room Camera' highlighted or selected in the camera list/settings menu.

task_completion.description: Agent identifies and records the Device ID (UUID) of the Server Room Camera.

task_completion.description: Agent documents the camera name and UUID in the specified audit log file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal window or text editor showing the file /home/ga/audit/camera_removal.txt containing 'Server Room Camera' and its corresponding UUID.

task_completion.visual_evidence: A confirmation dialog for deleting the camera, or the camera list showing 'Server Room Camera' is no longer present after a 'Delete' or 'Remove' action.

integrity.description: Agent used the VMS web interface for decommissioning rather than just CLI scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the browser interacting with the Nx Witness web UI elements (buttons, menus) to find and delete the camera.

integrity.description: The UUID in the audit log matches the UUID displayed in the VMS interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The UUID string visible in the VMS settings screenshot must match the text written into /home/ga/audit/camera_removal.txt.

integrity.description: The audit log is created/updated after the camera information is found in the VMS.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the VMS interface being explored before the terminal/editor is used to write the audit log.
